rules.description: Vicinae: Command + J/K → Control + J/K (move down/up the list in vim keybinding mode), Command + H/L → Left/Right
Telegram: Command + J/K → Option + Down/Up (next/previous chat), Command + S → Command + K (search chats)
Command + Delete → Option + Delete (Delete Word) [except Finder]
Dual-role CapsLock: Esc when tapped; Control in Kitty/WezTerm/UTM/Emacs/Ghostty, Command elsewhere when held.
Super key: Left Command → lazy Right Command (Super), Right Command → Left Command [generated by superkey]
